tasks.title: A1 roadmap 07: Sentence building
tasks.objective: Use the roadmap topic in a contextual grammar, vocabulary, reading and scripted-listening practice set.
tasks.context:
French source (fictional teaching situation):
Un visiteur demande : « Vous parlez anglais ? » Nora répond : « Non, je ne parle pas anglais. Je parle français. » Le visiteur demande alors de parler lentement.

Notice: In a standard written negative, ne comes before the conjugated verb and pas after it; ne elides to n’ before a vowel.
Model: Je ne parle pas anglais.
Meaning: I do not speak English.

Useful expressions: une question = a question; lentement = slowly; bien sûr = of course

exercises.explanation: In a standard written negative, ne comes before the conjugated verb and pas after it; ne elides to n’ before a vowel. Model meaning: I do not speak English.
options: Je parle ne pas anglais.
Je ne pas parle anglais.
Je ne parle pas anglais.

exercises.prompt: Match these contextual expressions to their English meanings.
exercises.instructions: Use the meaning taught for this situation, not every possible dictionary meaning.
exercises.explanation: The expressions are glossed in the lesson context.

data.text_fr: Visiteur : Est-ce que vous parlez français ? Nora : Oui. Visiteur : Pouvez-vous parler lentement ? Nora : Oui, bien sûr.

tasks.title: A1 roadmap 08: Everyday activities
tasks.objective: Use the roadmap topic in a contextual grammar, vocabulary, reading and scripted-listening practice set.
tasks.context:
French source (fictional teaching situation):
En semaine, Lina se lève à sept heures. Elle prend le bus à huit heures. Le dimanche, elle se lève à neuf heures. Ce matin est un lundi.

Notice: The reflexive pronoun follows the subject: je me lève, tu te lèves. The present can describe a usual routine.
Model: Je me lève à sept heures.
Meaning: I get up at seven.

Useful expressions: se lever = to get up; en semaine = on weekdays; prendre le bus = to take the bus

Je se lève à sept heures.

tasks.title: A1 roadmap 09: Family and people
tasks.objective: Use the roadmap topic in a contextual grammar, vocabulary, reading and scripted-listening practice set.
tasks.context:
French source (fictional teaching situation):
Dans cette famille imaginaire, Inès a un frère et une sœur. Sa sœur a un vélo bleu. Son frère a un petit sac noir. Le vélo n’appartient pas au frère.

Notice: A possessive agrees with the possessed noun: ma sœur, mon frère, mes parents. It does not describe the owner’s gender.
Model: Ma sœur a un vélo bleu.
Meaning: My sister has a blue bicycle.

Useful expressions: ma sœur = my sister; mon frère = my brother; les cheveux bruns = brown hair

tasks.title: A1 roadmap 10: Food and shopping
tasks.objective: Use the roadmap topic in a contextual grammar, vocabulary, reading and scripted-listening practice set.
tasks.context:
French source (fictional teaching situation):
Au marché, les pommes coûtent trois euros le kilo. Nora achète deux kilos. Elle paie six euros. Elle demande aussi du pain, mais le texte ne donne pas son prix.

Notice: After a stated quantity use de: deux kilos de pommes. In this positive food request du is a partitive, not a count of individual units.
Model: Je voudrais deux kilos de pommes.
Meaning: I would like two kilos of apples.

Useful expressions: un kilo = a kilogram; du pain = some bread; sans sucre = without sugar

Je voudrais deux kilos de pommes.

tasks.title: A1 roadmap 11: Places and directions
tasks.objective: Use the roadmap topic in a contextual grammar, vocabulary, reading and scripted-listening practice set.
tasks.context:
French source (fictional teaching situation):
La gare est devant la place. Il y a une pharmacie près de la gare, à gauche de la boulangerie. La bibliothèque est derrière la place. Ce plan est imaginaire.

Notice: Il y a introduces what exists in a place. For a simple location, près de means near and à gauche means on the left.
Model: Il y a une pharmacie près de la gare.
Meaning: There is a pharmacy near the station.

Useful expressions: tout droit = straight ahead; à gauche = on the left; près de la gare = near the station

tasks.title: A1 roadmap 12: Essential conversation
tasks.objective: Use the roadmap topic in a contextual grammar, vocabulary, reading and scripted-listening practice set.
tasks.context:
French source (fictional teaching situation):
Il pleut aujourd’hui. Léa ne va pas au parc. Elle va regarder un film chez elle ce soir. Elle invite Hugo, qui aime le cinéma.

Notice: Futur proche uses a present form of aller plus an infinitive. A demonstrative such as ce agrees with its noun: ce soir.
Model: Ce soir, je vais regarder un film.
Meaning: Tonight I am going to watch a film.

Useful expressions: il pleut = it is raining; ce soir = tonight; à tout à l’heure = see you shortly

Ce soir, je vais regarde un film.
Ce soir, je va regarder un film.

exercises.instructions: Supply only the missing model word or phrase. Retain French accents; this is supported form practice, not free translation.
